ns2:section.sectionText: RESIDENTAL LIFE/HOUSING Para-Professional Staff Course. Students eligible for registration in this course will be notified. 10 Week second half-session class. Meets in 2003 SDRP. 2 hours (letter-graded) credit. The MANDATORY Fall Retreat Day is Saturday, September 22, 2012. Classes begin the week of September 24th, 2012. Courses for Housing Para-Professional Staff by application. See: www.go.illinois.edu/Parapro. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can call Residential Life or Nathan Sanden in Housing at 333-0770.
